cell_kind: SAME-FLIGHT NODE COLUMN of two sampling levers -- 2 candidate arms (L1 Solver sample-and-commit, L2 Perception sample-and-merge) + the twin aa paired per row against the delivering lock arm; claim ceiling nominated
claim_boundary: No benefit, system-level, superiority, generalisation, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim.

contacts.scorer: CPU official scorer jobs over derived copies only

next_step: a NOMINATED arm goes to the 335 B Fold A column (stated, not built); the composed L1+L2 arm is not flown here

primary.contrast: arm minus lock, paired per row
primary.metric: official SLURP SLU-F1 (L1) and intent accuracy (L2) per arm column (one complete scoring per column, slurp-slu-official-train)

stages.1_columns: bash scripts/flights/nx/l338_read.sh columns  (stage3_rollout_score --mode perception-branches: one complete official scoring per arm; no number printed)
stages.smoke: python -B scripts/analysis/slurp_l338_column_read.py --stage smoke (per-arm decode cost and the v6 sampling receipt; no countersignature; the machine sign-off input for the column flight)

what_is_not_here: No margins block and no admission: nothing is locked here.

L1.HARM: SLU delta CI95 upper bound < -1.49 pp, or intent delta CI95 upper bound < -0.65 pp
L1.NOMINATED: SLU delta CI95 lower bound >= 1.49 pp AND intent delta CI95 upper bound >= -0.65 pp (no resolved intent loss)

L2.HARM: intent delta CI95 upper bound < -0.65 pp, or SLU delta CI95 upper bound < -1.49 pp
L2.NOMINATED: intent delta CI95 lower bound >= 0.65 pp AND SLU delta CI95 upper bound >= -1.49 pp (no resolved SLU loss)
